title: dev.qory.run.policy_applied
description: The policy the run is pinned to, with where it came from, and the variables the agent's process received. Emitted at the open, after dev.qory.run.started, with variables empty; at each join, after its dev.qory.session.started, with that session's variables, credential_variables and harness_hosts; and again at the sequence where a later run configuration from the server takes effect, with the variables of the session that runs then, none when no session runs. Each credential's and tool's name and argument, each variable's name, and the image, that contains qak_, qrk_, qecr_, qecn_, qecp_, qecg_ or qeci_ in any case is `(a name that contains an access key secret)` in its place, `(a name that contains a run key)` when it contains qrk_ and no qak_, `(a name that contains a run code)` when it contains qecr_ and neither of the others, or `(a name that contains an enrolment code)` when it contains qecn_, qecp_, qecg_ or qeci_ and none of the others.

enum: observe
enforce

allow.description: The allow list in force: the policy's entries. When the node's policy narrows a server's, the hosts both allow: under enforce on both sides each side's entries the other side's list covers, each once; under enforce on one side that side's; else the server's. The hosts the harness declared do not narrow it.

allow_first.description: The allow_first list in force: the policy's entries, each allowed by name in either mode before deny and allow. When the node's policy narrows a server's, each side's entries that the other side allows, the server's first, each once. Absent means an empty list.

deny.description: The deny list in force: the policy's entries, each denied by name in either mode, and when the node's policy narrows a server's, both sides' entries, the server's first. Absent means an empty list.

source.description: config when a policy document is passed to Forager; fetched when the policy is the security_policy of a run configuration the server returned, narrowed by the node's policy when there is one; none when there was neither and the gateway observes everything. With config or none, url and run_configuration are present when the server returned a run configuration without a security_policy.
enum: none
config
fetched

url.description: The server's run endpoint, run.url, that answered the run configuration, when the server returned one.

digest.description: sha256 of the policy document as canonical JSON, hex, when source is config or fetched: the version stamp of the run's policy, the same for the same policy however it was written. Computed by Forager.

run_configuration.description: The server's digest of the run configuration document, as its X-Qory-Run-Configuration header contained it, when the server returned one: sha256= and the lower-case hex SHA-256 of the document's bytes as the server sent them.

paths.description: The policy's path rules, by host, when it has any: the server's, when the policy is fetched; node_policy contains the node's.

credentials.description: The credentials the run keeps outside the enclosure, as resolved before the runtime started: one entry per use, where each goes, how, and the argument the policy passed, or, from the gateway's selection, the run's label it took. Never a secret.

argument.description: The argument the policy's credentials entry passed, such as the repositories the secret is minted for: the same on every use of one credential. Absent when the entry passes none.

enum: bearer
basic
header

tools.description: The tools the run reaches, started before the runtime: each one's name, the argument the policy passed and the hosts it serves. Fixed for the run: every further policy_applied repeats them.

argument.description: The argument the policy's tools entry passed, such as the repository the tool is started for. Absent when the entry passes none.

image.description: The image the policy or the run configuration selects, which the run started in: the machine's name for it, or its reference pinned by digest. Absent when neither selects one and the machine's default was used. Fixed for the run. An image that contains qak_, qrk_, qecr_, qecn_, qecp_, qecg_ or qeci_ in any case is one of four phrases in its place: the access key secret's when it contains qak_, else the run key's when it contains qrk_, else the run code's when it contains qecr_, else the enrolment code's.

enum: (a name that contains an access key secret)
(a name that contains a run key)
(a name that contains a run code)
(a name that contains an enrolment code)

terminated.description: The hosts the proxy terminates TLS for in this run: the ones a credential is for, the ones a tool serves and the ones with path rules. Every other host is a tunnel the proxy does not read. A credential's *. entry is not for a name under it that ends in .local, .internal or .home.arpa, such as x.home.arpa under *.arpa: the credential is for such a name only through an entry equal to it. A credential's *. entry under which every name has one of these endings, such as *.local, is not listed for the credential; it is listed when a tool serves it or it has path rules.

stack_hosts.description: The stack_hosts of the run configuration the run started with, as the document lists them, when it has them: until the run's first join request the stack proxy allows a host of them beside gateway.stack_hosts when the node's policy allows it and has no path rule for it. Present in the open's record and in each join's record before a later run configuration takes effect; absent from the record of a later run configuration, since a run's stack_hosts are fixed when it starts.

harness_hosts.description: The egress the session's harness declared, as passed to Forager, when present; absent at the open. Information only: it decides nothing. A host that contains qak_, qrk_, qecr_, qecn_, qecp_, qecg_ or qeci_ in any case is `(a value that contains an access key secret)` in its place, `(a value that contains a run key)` when it contains qrk_ and no qak_, `(a value that contains a run code)` when it contains qecr_ and neither of the others, or `(a value that contains an enrolment code)` when it contains qecn_, qecp_, qecg_ or qeci_ and none of the others.

node_policy.description: The node's policy, when the run has both a fetched policy and a policy the command passes, which narrows it, so the record shows the path rules of the server's policy and of the node's.

digest.description: sha256= and the lower-case hex SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 serialisation of the node's policy document, the policy.schema.json document the command passes.

paths.description: The node's path rules, by host, when it has any. A request to a host either side lists must match an entry of each side that lists it.

ceiling_paths.description: The path rules of each ceiling the run's policy file was put under with gateway.Policy.Under, by host, one object per ceiling that has any; absent when none has any. A request to a host a ceiling lists must match an entry of that ceiling as well. Fixed for the run: every further policy_applied repeats it.

variables.description: The run's variables by name, never a value: each name, the source whose value the run applies, and the values that lost, sorted by each variable's name as the run sets it, before a phrase takes the place of a name that contains qak_, qrk_, qecr_, qecn_, qecp_, qecg_ or qeci_. A name is listed when the server, the run, the machine or the harness's defaults set it, and when the built-in deny list or the endpoint rule leaves out a value the harness computed. A fixed name, one Forager, the wall, the runtime's preparation, a placeholder or the harness's computed values set, is listed only when it won over one of those sources, and a name of the environment the run inherits only when one of those sources set it too, so the inherited environment and Forager's names do not fill every record. Empty at the open, before any session; fixed when a session starts: every further policy_applied during that session repeats it.

name.description: The variable's name, or, for a name that contains qak_, qrk_, qecr_, qecn_, qecp_, qecg_ or qeci_ in any case, one of four phrases in its place: the access key secret's when it contains qak_, else the run key's when it contains qrk_, else the run code's when it contains qecr_, else the enrolment code's.

enum: (a name that contains an access key secret)
(a name that contains a run key)
(a name that contains a run code)
(a name that contains an enrolment code)

from.description: The source whose value the run applies, from the highest: fixed, apiary (the server's run configuration), run, machine, harness (the harness's written defaults), shell (the inherited environment). An open list: a receiver shows a name it does not know as it is. Absent when no source's value applies, as for a variable the runtime declares, which then goes into a walled run empty.

lost.description: The values of this name the run left out, the highest source first, each once: the source, and why: overridden, a higher source's value applies; denied, the deny list matched the name, or the server's value is of a variable the runtime declares or reserves or a machine value is read from; fixed, the name is one of the run's fixed names; unwalled, the server's value in a run without a wall that takes none; endpoint_uncovered, the endpoint's host is none of the hosts of the run's model credential; endpoint_unreadable, the value is not an https URL with a host Forager reads. An open list, as from is.

kept.description: Where the endpoint rule applies, behind a wall and without one for a run whose gateway holds credentials for it, why the value of the runtime's model endpoint variable that applies was kept: why endpoint_covered, the endpoint's host is a host of the run's model credential, and credential, that credential's name. Absent for every other value.

enum: endpoint_covered

credential_variables.description: With or without a wall, the variables the agent's process receives as a placeholder for a credential the gateway holds, never a value: one entry per credential and variable, in the order of the run answer's credential_hosts and of each credential's placeholders, the variable the session gives the start key, the model key the runtime starts with, after them. credential is the credential's name. A credential's name or a variable that contains qak_, qrk_, qecr_, qecn_, qecp_, qecg_ or qeci_ in any case is one of four phrases in its place: the access key secret's when it contains qak_, else the run key's when it contains qrk_, else the run code's when it contains qecr_, else the enrolment code's, so the record contains none of them. Absent when there is no entry, and at the open. The session decides it; fixed when a session starts: every further policy_applied during that session repeats it.

enum: (a name that contains an access key secret)
(a name that contains a run key)
(a name that contains a run code)
(a name that contains an enrolment code)
